title: Session flow and visual specification
acceptance: Four screens plus error, pause and source states; walkthrough with game/data leads

title: Connection and calibration screens
acceptance: Mocked ready/poor/failed/calibrating states and real command hooks; no headset required for UI development

title: Play HUD and results
acceptance: Time, score, source, assistance and pause reason; result and next-visitor reset

title: Explicit session state management
acceptance: Transitions enforced; reconnect never silently restarts; input-mode changes reset round

title: Accessibility and responsive polish
acceptance: Keyboard focus, non-color states, laptop/narrow layouts, offline font fallback

title: Instructions and operator display
acceptance: Visitor understands assisted mechanic; operator can inspect quality without cluttering game

title: Tune and expose game configuration
acceptance: Deterministic low/high input trials quantified; enjoyable disturbance and center-zone tuning

title: Round lifecycle and practice separation
acceptance: 60-second round; live/replay rounds ignore keyboard; pauses freeze time/score; reset is complete

title: Rendering and feedback polish
acceptance: Smooth beam/ball; assistance feedback and round-end presentation; no borrowed assets required

title: Input smoothing and latency tuning
acceptance: No abrupt jumps; one documented smoothing owner; measured score-to-game latency

title: Physics and score behavior checks
acceptance: Frame-rate invariance, boundaries, pause, reset, stale input and score bounds verified

title: Headset inventory and feasibility spike
acceptance: Exact device/OS/access; continuous raw recording and reconnect, or precise blocker and alternate route

title: Live adapter and rolling buffer
acceptance: Single acquisition session; channel/rate/unit metadata; bounded buffer; clean stop/reconnect

title: Filtering and band-power extraction
acceptance: One documented pipeline with correct axes/sample rate; raw preserved; synthetic frequency check

title: Signal-quality gating
acceptance: Flags missing/clipped/flat/contact/motion issues; invalid windows never advance calibration or score

title: Calibration and baseline input mapping
acceptance: Valid clean baseline; flat-baseline failure; normalized bounded output; repeated-person check

title: Raw recording, feature logs and replay
acceptance: Raw+metadata+events saved locally; replay preserves source and timestamps; no recordings in Git

title: Live repeatability and controllability pilot
acceptance: Repeated instructed blocks across at least 3 volunteers; usable-data fraction and artifact review; report no effect honestly

title: Protocol fixtures and schemas
acceptance: Input/control/status agreed; valid/poor/stale/malformed fixtures match Python and TypeScript

title: Shared acquisition service and bounded broadcast
acceptance: One producer for multiple clients; slow client cannot stall collection; queue sizes bounded

title: Session commands and status
acceptance: Connect/calibrate/reset/stop commands acknowledged; status is truthfully synced with browser

title: Recovery and local configuration
acceptance: Explicit source selection; disconnect/reconnect/failure states; shutdown closes headset; backend URL configurable

title: Backend contract and lifecycle checks
acceptance: WebSocket, calibration failure, duplicate sessions and disconnect checked with fixtures

title: Fresh-checkout setup and onboarding
acceptance: Two members independently run manual and synthetic modes; supported runtime matrix documented

title: Automated cross-component checks
acceptance: Playwright simulated round/source/quality/reset tests; CI backend behavioral checks

title: Failure and performance rehearsal
acceptance: Stale/poor/reconnect/tab-hidden/input-change tested; sustained laptop FPS and packet lag recorded

title: Visitor testing and coordinated fixes
acceptance: Five new visitors; setup times/completion/confusion captured; UI/data owners address findings

title: Local launch, attribution and backup demo
acceptance: Launch instructions/optional script; version pins and notices; labeled replay/video works offline

title: Showcase poster and ten-round rehearsal
acceptance: Explain measurement and automation; ten consecutive rounds; reset and operator briefing

title: Collection and evaluation protocol
acceptance: Repeated task blocks, counterbalancing, task markers, split plan, voluntary local recording

title: Dataset collection and quality audit
acceptance: Pilot participants/sessions collected; retained/rejected windows reported; no claimed generalization

title: Feature baseline and classifier training
acceptance: Dummy + simple feature + StandardScaler/LogisticRegression; session/block-held-out evaluation

title: Evaluation report and adoption gate
acceptance: Per-session metrics, artifact/confound review, latency, balanced accuracy and live comparison

title: Versioned inference adapter
acceptance: Same feature order/preprocessing, local trusted artifact, fallback explicit, same input score contract
